examples.text: She plays squash every Saturday.

glosses: A preparation made by placing material on a slide (flat, rectangular piece of glass), covering it and applying pressure.
Something soft and easily crushed; especially, an unripe pod of peas.
Something unripe or soft.

An extremely one-sided, usually short, match.

examples.text: It was one of the most shocking WWE title matches ever witnessed, and effectively a 20-minute squash match as Brock Lesnar "conquered" his opponent.

glosses: To beat or press into pulp or a flat mass; to crush.
To compress or restrict (oneself) into a small space; to squeeze.

examples.text: Somehow, she squashed all her books into her backpack, which was now too heavy to carry.

glosses: To suppress; to force into submission.

examples.text: A somewhat popular myth about the Whiskey Rebellion is that Washington personally led the troops into western Pennsylvania and squashed the rebellion.

glosses: The sound of something relatively heavy splashing or squelching into water.

examples.text: […] rain, too, had lately fallen, and had decidedly not evaporated, since, at every step, I went squash! squash! up to the tops of my boots, and many times very extent, stretching to the eastward, […]

1883, May 5 […] The words had only left his mouth when his feet slipped from under him, and with a dull, sickening thud, he went squash! into the water, waist-deep. We made our way to bed in a silence that was painful.

examples.text: Игра в сквош во многом похожа на теннис. С той только разницей, что игроки не перекидывают мяч через сетку, а поочерёдно ударяют им по стене. Причём так, чтобы соперник не смог отразить удара.

translations.source_sense_description: Sportart für zwei Spieler, bei der ein Ball mit Schlägern gegen eine Wand gespielt wird

glosses: Deporte en el que se golpea con raqueta una pelota de goma contra una pared. Se practica en interior con dos jugadores, y la pelota puede tener distintos grados de velocidad o rebote que se identifica por el color. Los jugadores golpean la pelota con sus raquetas haciéndola rebotar en la pared frontal de la pista. La pelota puede rebotar en todas las paredes cuantas veces sea necesario y en cualquier orden, siempre que golpee en la pared frontal o frontis antes de tocar el suelo. Solo puede rebotar en el suelo una vez, si rebota dos o más veces, es punto para el contrincante.
